As part of this analysis, we also need to understand our employee hierarchy and their respective capability levels to ensure compensation aligns with roles and responsibilities. Additionally, we'll need to review our salary bands and grade levels to confirm they're being applied consistently across the company.

This activity requires HR compensation management or job grading system APIs/agents that can read, compare, and validate salary bands and grade level definitions — capabilities not present in these candidates despite their topical relevance to workforce management.
